conbody.p: Clause Library is a library of clauses, or clause templates, that each contains modular blocks of contractual language that can be reused across multiple contract templates. Clause Library helps you to search for clauses or supporting documents that can be inserted into the template as inline text.

note.p: You cannot use the Clause Library to insert clauses unless the template you are working with has already been checked in at least once. If you are in the process of creating a new template, check in the template and open it again to start using Clause Library. Clauses are not supported in headers and footers in templates
